decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing builds directly on the firm's established managed voice and collaboration services, so its existing technical and customer knowledge lets it interpret early demand and improve the offer, making withdrawal unlikely.

The positive market result already reported for the Hong Kong Metro data centre connection and its closeness to the firm's existing network services indicate strong absorptive capacity, making dropping very unlikely.

Although optical spectrum connectivity extends the firm's offer, it builds on the firm's core fibre and wavelength knowledge and has its own product page, signalling commitment and ability to learn from early results.
The voice number ordering portal is close to the firm's established voice services and leverages existing platforms, so the firm can readily assimilate customer feedback and is unlikely to drop it.
Carrier pre-selection telephony is close to the firm's existing voice and carrier services, giving the firm the related knowledge to assess and improve it, so it will probably be kept.

Direct voice network connection is also close to the firm's established network and voice capabilities, enabling the firm to recognise its value and learn from early market responses, so withdrawal is unlikely.
